title: Schema and instance metadata
description: Metadata on the header ($required, $unit, $maxItems, comments) describes every record; metadata on a value ($verified, #featured, #discontinued) describes one record. Both are skipped when decoding — the JSON is the same — but a model reads them.
question: Which products are verified and not discontinued? Give the sku and the price in EUR.

comments: Product catalogue: one named type with schema metadata
Schema metadata: rules for every product
Instance metadata: facts about one product

akd_meta: // $source="catalogue" $exported="2026-10-30" #snapshot // /* Product catalogue: one named type with schema metadata */ @Product<[/* Schema metadata: rules for every product */ sku:string $required /* stock keeping unit */,name:string $required,price:number $unit="EUR" $min=0,tags:[string] $maxItems=3]><products:@Product>([/* Instance metadata: facts about one product */ $verified=true ("PROD-123","Keyboard",89.0,["new","wireless"]) #featured,("PROD-124","Mouse",39.5,[]),$verified=true ("PROD-125","Dock",199.0,["usb-c"]),("PROD-126","Cable",9.99,["usb-c"]) #discontinued /* sold out, no restock */])
